definitions: To achieve two things at once with a single action.
To solve two problems with one solution.
examples: I can kill two birds with one stone by picking up groceries on my way home from work.
Working out and listening to an audiobook allows me to kill two birds with one stone.
The new policy aims to kill two birds with one stone: reduce waste and save money.
lemma: kill two birds with one stone
synonyms: hit two targets with one arrow
get two for the price of one
source: kill two birds with one stone
